$comment: Product analytics events. Shared by web (TS) and API (Python). Property types are closed on purpose: there is no free-text string type, so chat content, names, birth details or contact data cannot be sent. Add an event here before emitting it anywhere.

propertyTypes.path: URL path only, no query string or fragment: ^/[a-z0-9/_-]{0,199}$

envelope.anonymous_id: random id from a first-party cookie
envelope.user_id: opaque internal id or null; never phone or email

page_view.description: A page was rendered to a visitor.

tool_started.description: Visitor began filling a free tool form.

tool_completed.description: A free tool returned a result.

otp_requested.description: Phone OTP was requested. The phone number is never sent.

otp_verified.description: Phone OTP verified; the visitor is signed in.

kundli_saved.description: Signed-in user saved a kundli. Birth details are never sent.

session_requested.description: User asked an astrologer for a session.

session_ended.description: A consultation ended. Message content is never sent.

recharge_succeeded.description: Wallet recharge confirmed by the payment webhook.
